items.title: audit control construction in every random-minute study tool; add control-sanity data gate
items.evidence: bar_signal_family's one-sided exclusion inflated same-name controls (+11.6/+27.9 bp vs -7.5 bp for random minutes). board_structure_family (H1/H2) is symmetric (verified). ~20 other tools use random-minute controls and are unaudited: analyst_upgrade, book_walls, clock_windows, daily_filter_screen, early_entry_honest, first_presq_adversarial_argon, five_pillars_study, gate_counterfactual, momentum_alert_markouts, limit_below_study, momentum_runway_study, range_arm_control, runway_target_study, sector_study, sip_breakout_study and others. AUDIT RESULT (subagent + Argon, 11/07): none has the exact one-sided bug, but the stricter point holds - any same-name control drawn BEFORE the trigger sits on the path that made the stock fire. Flagged: sr_* family (5 tools, same-hour pool excluding only the trigger minute), range_arm_control (600 s exclusion vs 1800 s hold), premarket_depth_probe, sip_breakout_study, fib_pullback, structure_pullback, book_walls (300 s vs 600 s horizon), desk_vs_random/five_pillars/momentum_runway (full-day same-name), and board_structure_family H1/H2 (controls reach t-30..t-16). Clean: strictly-later or same-minute cross-name controls (early_entry_honest, limit_below, wr_trend_trade, etf_bars, first_presq_adversarial, analyst_upgrade, regime_beta_family B2 horizons).
items.next: Standard (P2). Rerun in this order: board_structure_family H1/H2, range_arm_control (only one where a pass is plausible), sr_* family, premarket_depth_probe, then the rest. Recorded FAILs that also fail on absolute net stay FAIL.
